PLAN "Perimenopause Strength & Bone Loading — 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

    name "Bone-loading compound strength for perimenopause"
  GOAL secondary body_composition:
    name "Muscle mass maintenance through hormonal transition"
  GOAL tertiary mobility:

          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          walking 5m

      DAY Tuesday training 50m "Upper Body Push A":

          walking 8m

          incline_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          shoulder_stretch 3m

      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Active Recovery & Core":

          walking 5m
